names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 7 august, «Sfântul Cuvios Nicanor», with the rank words left off. The page gives him no epithet; "of Zavorda" is the English form chosen here, from the monastery his life says he founded.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «Sfântul Nicanor s-a născut în anul 1491 la Salonic».

death.note: doxologia.ro: «a trecut la cele veșnice în ziua de 7 august 1549, la vârsta de numai 58 de ani».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 7 august — «Sfântul Cuvios Nicanor»

attestations.note: His own page gives the day as the day of his death, 7 August 1549.
Not checked: saint.gr for 7 Αυγούστου (24 September 2026). He is a Greek saint of Thessalonica and Grevena and a Greek commemoration is to be expected; it was not looked for.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
